Merriam-Webster Adds New Words Including 'Vibe Coding' and 'AGI'

Merriam-Webster has added approximately 1,400 new words to its dictionary, reflecting contemporary language and concepts. Among the additions are terms such as 'vibe coding,' 'meme coin,' 'parasocial,' 'AGI' (Artificial General Intelligence), and 'Sunday scaries.' The new entries aim to capture modern anxieties and cultural phenomena, including those related to digital life and emotional states.
